Lee Harvey Oswald, the accused assassin of President John F. Kennedy, was shot and killed on November 24, 1963, while being transferred from Dallas Police Headquarters. The shooting was captured on live television.

- Agents 2, 3, and 4 all say Jack Ruby (with very high confidence: 0.98, 1.00, 0.98)
